style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for the packshot, dreamy light-blue gradients #DCE9F7 to #CFE0F5 for benefit and mechanism screens, airy near-white blue #F5F8FC for infographic screens, deep sea blue #2E5FA3 reserved for the closing screen
style.iconSystem: thin rounded line icons and frosted glass circles, single accent color
style.lightingSystem: soft diffused glow light with pearlescent highlights, gentle rim light on bottle shoulders, soft contact shadows only, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dreamy aqua skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pearl white #FFFFFF, misty light blue #DCE9F7, deep sea blue accent #2E5FA3 and silver-grey highlight #C9D6E8; soft diffused glow lighting with pearlescent highlights and soft contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif with deep blue headlines on light panels; thin rounded line icons and frosted glass circles; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; the bottle always upright or gently floating, stable scale, single hero object; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no warm yellow cast anywhere in the set
style.presentationRules: the bottle stays upright or with a gentle diagonal float, stable scale, always the single hero object
style.surfaceSystem: seamless airy gradient backdrops with floating translucent bubbles and pearl bokeh, matte white info cards
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, deep sea blue #2E5FA3 headlines on light panels and white #FFFFFF on dark panels
